html:
The Gitga'at are a Tsimshian people whose village is Hartley Bay, on the north coast of British Columbia. Their territory, Lax Yuup, covers the nearby islands and channels.

In the 1800s many Gitga'at followed the missionary William Duncan to his Christian town of Metlakatla. A group returned in 1887 and founded the present village at Hartley Bay. In 2006 the BC ferry Queen of the North sank nearby, and Hartley Bay people went out in their boats in the night and rescued most of the passengers. Their neighbours include the Haisla and Kitasoo.
